stem: The warehouse agent can release a vehicle into a human work area. Which HITL control is most appropriate?

options.text: Require human approval with the proposed route, evidence, and stop/modify controls before release
Ask for approval after the vehicle moves
Let the agent decide because the route tool succeeded
Require a human to approve every harmless status read
